loader_kwargs.item_description: Cold-chain sensor kits for refrigerated distribution pilot

files.content:
# Sales Policy
COLD-CHAIN-SENSOR-40 may not sell below 174.00 per unit. Expedited cold-chain shipping requires approved surcharge terms.

# Shipping Terms
Allowed shipping_method values include refrigerated_ground and validated_cold_chain. Record delivery_date and temperature_range in every final order.

# Contract Template
Terms must list delivery_date, shipping_method, temperature_range, approval id, purchase order id, and item id.

tables.name: inventory

tables.name: price_book

tables.name: shipping_calendar
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE shipping_calendar (calendar_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL, shipping_method TEXT NOT NULL, capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: cold_chain_surcharges

tables.name: seller_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE seller_orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, buyer_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

files.content:
# Cold Chain Policy
Approval requires matching delivery_date, shipping_method, and temperature_range across buyer, seller, and approval records.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include delivery_date, shipping_method, temperature_range, and risk register id.

tables.name: approval_rules
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_rules (rule_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, threshold_unit_price REAL NOT NULL, max_total_price REAL NOT NULL)

tables.name: approval_log
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: shipment_risk_register
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE shipment_risk_register (risk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_date TEXT NOT NULL, shipping_method TEXT NOT NULL, temperature_range TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: delegations
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE delegations (delegate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)

Target unit price: 186.00
Required terms_json must include delivery_date, shipping_method, and temperature_range.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include delivery_date, shipping_method, and temperature_range in terms_json.
